description.value:
You touch a creature that died within the last minute and deliver a restorative electric shock, returning it to life with 1 hit point. This power cannot revive a creature that died of old age, nor restore missing body parts, and it automatically fails if the creature lacks organs essential to survival, such as its head.

A creature restored to life in this way cannot be affected by this power again until it completes a short or long rest.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 4
